display_long_description:
THE FUTURE OF TRAINING IS HERE

VR training tracks and measures skill, aptitude, speed, dexterity, and endurance – and more! Perfect for training the industrial and commercial workforce. It’s an easy and cost-effective way to train your new hires without expensive capital outlay.

THE VIRTUAL REVOLUTION IS NOW REALITY

Attract more millennial talent to your organization, the largest and fastest-growing workforce.

Identify top talent.

Reduce training expenses.

Improve task retention and minimize accidents.

If you're looking to onboard employees quickly, without the danger of a live environment, VR training is the answer. Discover aptitude, pattern recognition, and teach processes in a safe place. For example:  

Master VR movement with VR Onboarding.

Work on an inspection line.

Identify tools properly, and put them away in the proper places.

Climb a tower and test for acrophobia.

Find items quickly for a shipment in Pick 'n Pack.

Learn how to extinguish a fire!
